saw_lines: Players pick a bag by what fits their paddles and shoes, then replace it when they upgrade gear.
So the sale is decided before the click, in whether the first line answers what fits and what it costs.
Your 15 of 26 copy ads open on the same “not every bag has to” line, so run three new openers built on the laptop fit and lifetime warranty.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 19 Oct 2026
points: 15 of your 26 copy ads open on “not every bag has to”, so one story keeps reaching the same buyers. Run three new openers from your product: the 16 inch laptop, 2 paddles and 3 balls, and the lifetime warranty.
Your site shows 745 reviews and a 4.6 rating, yet 0 of 26 copy ads carry a proof number. New buyers need that proof. Put one review count on every creative, like 745 reviews at 4.6 stars, up top.

Your site offers free shipping, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a new buyer has no answer before the click. Put free shipping in the first line of three new ads and name the delivery window too.

Your site lists the bags at $400, yet 0 of 30 ads mention price, so buyers cannot judge value before the click. Lead one ad with the $400 price beside your travel gear comparison, then show the 2 paddle, 3 ball and 16 inch laptop fit.

ads_1: New openers on laptop fit and lifetime warranty, tested against the current hook
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
